description: Stop a file sent with create_mailbox_batch. Every row still queued stops now, as failed with the reason `cancelled`, and its stored password is deleted. If the file was sent in the current clock hour, the mailbox checks those rows booked go back to the workspace's hourly count. A row already checking finishes as it would, connected or failed, because a login is never cut off. Rows that connected stay connected. The answer is the file as get_mailbox_batch gives it, with `cancelledAt` set: keep calling get_mailbox_batch until no row is queued or checking, and then another file can start. Canceling a file with no row queued or checking changes nothing and answers the file as it is. A canceled row's password is gone, so to connect that mailbox, call connect_mailbox or connect_send_only_mailbox. It needs setup permission. A signed-in owner has it and can give it to an API key for the whole workspace. That key loses it if its maker stops being the owner.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

name: cancel_mailbox_batch
title: Cancel a file of mailboxes
